caption:
“Central Asian Innovation Hubs” alyansi Tojikistonning qo‘shilishi bilan kengaydi. Kelishuv Yaponiyada bo‘lib o‘tgan birinchi “C5+1” sammiti doirasida IT Park Uzbekistan bosh direktori Abdulaxad Kuchkarov, “Astana Hub” bosh direktori Magjan Madiyev va “IT Park Dushanbe” bosh direktori Temur Hisamutdinov tomonidan imzolangan memorandum bilan mustahkamlandi.

Natijada, Tojikiston startaplari Markaziy Osiyoning boshqa mamlakatlari startaplari bilan bir qatorda alyansning akseleratsiya dasturlari, xalqaro texnologik ko‘rgazmalar va bozorga chiqish bo‘yicha tizimli yordamdan foydalanish imkoniyatiga ega bo‘ladilar.

📖 Batafsil ma’lumot uchun to‘liq maqolani o‘qing: it-park.uz

—

The Central Asian Innovation Hubs alliance expanded with the accession of Tajikistan, formalized through a memorandum signed at the first C5+1 Summit in Japan by Abdulakhad Kuchkarov, CEO of IT Park Uzbekistan, Magzhan Madiev, CEO of Astana Hub, and Temur Khisamutdinov, CEO of IT Park Dushanbe. 

As a result, startups from Tajikistan will gain access to the alliance’s acceleration programs, international technology exhibitions, and structured market-entry support alongside startups from other Central Asian countries.
